title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
description: Former CIA agent Bob Baer launches a global investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy and tracks the movements of Lee Harvey Oswald; Baer discovers a CIA document revealing that Oswald met with Soviet officials in Mexico City.

title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
description: Bob Baer explores the connections between Lee Harvey Oswald and the Russian government; the team tracks down a former KGB officer whose stunning testimony jolts the investigation.

title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
description: Bob and his team focus their efforts on Louisiana, where Lee Harvey Oswald lived in the months prior to the murder of President Kennedy; the team uncovers a period of time during which no one can account for Oswald's whereabouts or activities.

title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald

title: JFK Declassified: Tracking Oswald
